Tests for relative pkg path queries in a non-module (GOPATH) view.

-- env --
GOPATH=$SANDBOX_WORKDIR
GO111MODULE=off

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- src/root.go --
package root

-- src/a/a.go --
package a

import (
	_ "a/empty/sub"
	_ "c"
)

var A = "a" //@target(a_A, "a", "A", "A")

type StructA struct {
	Field int //@target(a_Field, "a", "Field", "Field")
}

// Local symbol without pkg specified
//@resolvetarget("A", "", a_A)
//@resolvetarget("StructA.Field", "", a_Field)

// Relative to package a ("a/b")
//@resolvetarget("b.B", "", b_B)
//@resolvetarget("B", "b", b_B)

// Full GOPATH package path ("c")
//@resolvetarget("c.C", "", c_C)
//@resolvetarget("C", "c", c_C)

-- src/a/b/b.go --
package b

var B = "b" //@target(b_B, "a/b", "B", "B")

-- src/c/c.go --
package c

var C = "c" //@target(c_C, "c", "C", "C")

-- src/a/ --
// Directory with a package in GOPATH mode:
// Local symbol without pkg specified
//@resolvetarget("A", "", a_A)
//@resolvetarget("StructA.Field", "", a_Field)

// Relative to package at uri ("a/b", "a/empty/sub")
//@resolvetarget("b.B", "", b_B)
//@resolvetarget("B", "b", b_B)
//@resolvetarget("empty/sub.S", "", sub_S)
//@resolvetarget("S", "empty/sub", sub_S)

// Same-directory package name ("a")
//@resolvetarget("a.A", "", a_A)
//@resolvetarget("A", "a", a_A)

// Full GOPATH package path ("a/b", "c")
//@resolvetarget("a/b.B", "", b_B)
//@resolvetarget("c.C", "", c_C)

// Local import path ("./b", "../c")
//@resolvetarget("./b.B", "", b_B)
//@resolvetarget("../c.C", "", c_C)

-- src/a/empty/sub/sub.go --
package sub

var S = "s" //@target(sub_S, "a/empty/sub", "S", "S")

-- src/a/empty/ --
// Directory without a package in GOPATH mode:
// Full GOPATH package paths work (Rule 2)
//@resolvetarget("a.A", "", a_A)
//@resolvetarget("a/b.B", "", b_B)
//@resolvetarget("a/empty/sub.S", "", sub_S)
//@resolvetarget("c.C", "", c_C)

// Local import paths with "./" or "../" work (Rule 1)
//@resolvetarget("./sub.S", "", sub_S)
//@resolvetarget("S", "./sub", sub_S)
//@resolvetarget("../b.B", "", b_B)
//@resolvetarget("B", "../b", b_B)

// Relative package paths without "./" or "../" from a package-less directory
// in a non-module view resolve via packagesInDir fallback.
//@resolvetarget("sub.S", "", sub_S)
//@resolvetarget("S", "sub", sub_S)

// Unqualified symbol in a directory without a package fails.
//@resolvetarget("A", "", err="no package metadata for directory")
